gloss: the present moment, at this point

definitions.gloss: the present moment, at this point in time
definitions.explanation: Refers to the current point in time, emphasizing that a situation or assessment is based on the present circumstances and may change. Common in formal reports, news, and business communication.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧です。
examples.english: It is undecided at this point.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かっている→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will share the information that is known at this time.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧しきれて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The extent of the damage at this point has not been fully grasped, but a detailed investigation is planned going forward.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ as {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ or {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ to mean "at this point in time." Implies that the situation may change in the future. Common in news reports, official statements, and business communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (at the present moment)
- {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (information as of now)
- {現時点|げんじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かっている→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧こと (what is known at this point)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧: currently, at present (more general, used in both formal and informal contexts)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧: for now, at this point (more conversational)
- ⟦{目下|もっか}→目下：20494_mokka⟧: at present, currently (formal, literary)
